sections.text:

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text:
Basic Attack
 Sanguine Absolution

sections.heading: BASIC ATTACK:
sections.text: Mi Fu can perform up to 5 basic attack sequences, dealing Heat DMG to enemies. When performing a finisher on an enemy, Camille deals massive Heat DMG and restores some SP.

sections.heading: DIVE ATTACK:
sections.text: Basic attack performed in mid-air becomes a dive attack that deals Physical DMG to nearby enemies.

sections.heading: FINISHER:
sections.text:
Basic attack performed near a Stagger ed enemy becomes a finisher attack that deals massive Physical DMG and recovers some SP.

 Battle Skill
 Blazing Exorcism
 SP Cost : 9999

 Summons Firefang Vesperwings to fly toward the enemy, dealing Heat DMG and applying Heat Infliction to a small area of enemies, triggering Weakness, and Heat Susceptibility to the target.
When the target is hit by Camille’s combo skill, it takes additional explosion DMG. If the enemy is defeated, Firefang Vesperwings will fly toward another nearby enemy.
 Multipliers (Rank 12)

 Show Effects

 Combo Skill
 Heartstake Thorn
 Cooldown: 9999 s

 Trigger: When an enemy’s Heat Infliction is consumed or absorbed. Performs a returning dash on the enemy, dealing Heat DMG and restoring some SP.

 Multipliers (Rank 12)

 Show Effects

 Ultimate
 Sanguine Downpour
 Energy cost : 9999

 Camille flies to the sky, rains down a barrage of spears, and follows through with a sweep attack. This deals Heat DMG and applies Heat Infliction to enemies over a large area while restoring some SP. Shortly after casting, Camille enters a temporary Hunter Pursuit State, and his next battle skill is converted to an Enhanced Combo.
